items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: Tito Puente arrangements but pared down to that small quartet group.

ctx.x: Maybe, you’re 19, you’re playing like “Night Train” or “Spanish Eyes” and then you guys go back and listen to hard bop?
No actually that Latin gig we weren’t playing “Night Train,” we were playing the Latin songs. Tito Puente arrangements but pared down to that small quartet group.

That’s very — was the music, obviously then that kind of music was popular enough that it got booked into a Catskills club. I guess this is an education for me, that that Latin music was popular enough for it to be a summer band.
